## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 365 captures during January 2020. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service delivery. No new equipment faults were reported during the month. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 365 captures, 8 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.2. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for grading, while a small number could not be used for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine quality review.

## Grading

A total of 57 results were graded referable during January 2020. The median grading lag was 1 day. This measure records the typical time between image capture and completion of grading. Activity, image quality, and grading results should be reviewed together to support ongoing oversight of the service at North City Eye Clinic.
